items.question: Is Lovart appropriate for sensitive causes?
items.answer: Yes. Mission storylines emphasize dignified storytelling and consistent brand trust — not sensational templates.

items.question: Can small comms teams use this?
items.answer: Built for lean teams. One development or comms staffer can produce full appeal kits without design training.

items.question: Multi-chapter or affiliate brands?
items.answer: Brand Kit locks core identity; chapters localize copy and offers within guidelines.

items.question: Grant and board presentation graphics?
items.answer: Generate impact snapshots, program explainers, and deck visuals from the same campaign context.

items.question: Volunteer-created content?
items.answer: Role-based access lets volunteers generate within brand guardrails — reducing off-brand posts.

items.question: Discounts for nonprofits?
items.answer: Check current pricing page for nonprofit or education programs; commercial usage included on paid plans.
